title: Andrew Wray
text:
I’m Andrew Wray, and I am a data scientist and mathematician based in Seattle, WA.
I received my Bachelor’s of Science in Math and Physics at Western Washington University in 2014, where I was recognized as WWU Math Department’s Outstanding Graduate. I completed my PhD in mathematics at the University of Oregon in June 2020 under the guidance of Nick Addington in the field of algebraic geometry. These days I work as a data scientist for Fullpower Technologies.
If you wish to get in contact with me, feel free to send me an email (andrew.s.wray at protonmail dot com) or reach out on LinkedIn.
